mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_BUDGET_DATA ( DATA_ID, TASK_ID, BUDGET_YEAR, BUDGET_PERIOD, ORGANIZATION_ID, INDICATOR_ID, INDICATOR_CODE, INDICATOR_NAME, BUDGET_VALUE, CURRENCY, DATA_SOURCE, DATA_STATUS, VERSION_NO, SCENARIO_ID, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, DEL_FLAG, TENANT_ID ) VALUES
( #{item.dataId}, #{item.taskId}, #{item.budgetYear}, #{item.budgetPeriod}, #{item.organizationId}, #{item.indicatorId}, #{item.indicatorCode}, #{item.indicatorName}, #{item.budgetValue}, #{item.currency}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.dataStatus}, #{item.versionNo}, #{item.scenarioId}, SYSDATE, #{item.createBy}, 0, #{item.tenantId} )

update.foreach: UPDATE TBL_BUDGET_DATA SET BUDGET_VALUE = #{item.budgetValue}, ACTUAL_VALUE = #{item.actualValue}, DATA_STATUS = #{item.dataStatus}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATE_BY = #{item.updateBy} WHERE DATA_ID = #{item.dataId}

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_BUDGET_DATA WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY INDICATOR_CODE
SELECT * FROM TBL_BUDGET_DATA WHERE INDICATOR_ID = #{indicatorId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY BUDGET_PERIOD
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BUDGET_DATA SET VARIANCE_VALUE = ACTUAL_VALUE - BUDGET_VALUE, VARIANCE_RATE = CASE WHEN BUDGET_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (ACTUAL_VALUE - BUDGET_VALUE) / BUDGET_VALUE * 100 END, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE DATA_ID = #{dataId}
